description: Source code for the PdfFlattenVisitor class, which flattens document elements for PDF rendering within the MigraDoc library. It includes methods for processing document elements, text, formatting, and hyperlinks.

classes.name: PdfFlattenVisitor
classes.description: A visitor class that traverses document objects to flatten and prepare them for PDF rendering, handling text segmentation, formatting, and hyperlinks.

methods.name: VisitDocumentElements
methods.description: Processes a collection of document elements, splitting paragraphs on breaks.

methods.name: VisitDocumentObjectCollection
methods.description: Processes a collection of document objects, inserting line breaks and handling special characters in text.

methods.name: VisitFormattedText
methods.description: Adjusts font styles based on styles and parent objects.

methods.name: VisitHyperlink
methods.description: Handles hyperlink styling, applying default styles if necessary.

methods.name: GetParentFont
methods.description: Retrieves the font style from the parent object, which can be a paragraph, hyperlink, or formatted text.
